job.title: Automotive Electrician
job.description:
Auto Electrician - FIFO Pilbara | 2:1 Roster

We are seeking an experienced Auto Electrician to join a Pilbara maintenance team on a full-time FIFO 2:1 roster.

This is a varied, hands-on role working across a broad fleet of buses, heavy vehicles, light vehicles and site equipment. You will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing and maintaining electrical systems to keep vehicles safe, reliable and operational in a remote environment.


What’s on offer

  • Full-time position with weekly pay
  • 2:1 FIFO roster
  • Guaranteed minimum 10-hour days, with the team currently working 11.5-hour days
  • Standard hours are 6:00am-6:00pm, with a 30-minute lunch break
  • Occasional breakdown and additional-hours work, managed in line with fatigue requirements
  • Paid travel time, subject to agreed travel arrangements
  • Daily meal allowance
  • Shared accommodation in the Pilbara
  • Vehicles available for travel to local shops


The role

You will complete electrical diagnostics, fault-finding, repairs and preventative maintenance across a diverse range of vehicles and equipment, including:

  • Buses and coaches, including electric buses
  • Prime movers and heavy vehicles
  • Light vehicles, utes and cars
  • Cranes and site equipment
  • Golf carts, lawn mowers and small equipment


You will work with a range of leading systems and brands, including Cummins, Allison, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz, BCI and Yutong.


About you

You will be a trade-qualified Auto Electrician with strong diagnostic and fault-finding capability. Experience working on buses, coaches, heavy vehicles, mobile plant or light vehicles will be highly regarded.

You will also bring:

  • A safety-first attitude and pride in quality workmanship
  • The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
  • Confidence diagnosing wiring, charging, starting, lighting, control and electrical systems
  • A willingness to work in a remote FIFO environment


Apply now to discuss the opportunity.
